task: Review the Pocket Spatial iPhone 6 Wikimedia Commons catalog-button failure after a merged closure fix still appears to do nothing on-device. Focus on old Safari/iOS 12 caching and dynamic script loading. Current architecture: pocket-spatial.html loads pocket-spatial-core.js by stable relative URL; core dynamically appends pocket-spatial-commons.js, then SoundCloud scripts, also by stable relative URLs. We gave the user a cache-busted HTML URL query, but the dynamically loaded JS URLs themselves were unchanged. The Commons closure bug was fixed and CI now literally triggers the catalog button in a fake DOM, but the physical iPhone 6 still shows no visible response. Please assess whether stale script cache is the most likely explanation, identify other iOS 12-specific failure modes that could produce a silent tap, and recommend the smallest robust fix plus a way to make future deployed builds self-identifying and cache-safe. Do not suggest user account setup. Preserve ES5/iOS 12 compatibility and the existing DSP architecture.
